latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of YouTube Reporting API integration with managed OAuth.

- Schedule and manage bulk YouTube Analytics reporting jobs via a unified API.
- Download daily-generated YouTube Analytics reports as CSV files.
- List available report types for both channels and playlists.
- Manage multiple YouTube account connections with easy OAuth management.
- Secure API access with Maton API key authentication.
